title: The Lazy Spinner
summary: A lazy wife told her husband she could not spin because she had no wooden reel. When he went to cut wood, she hid in the bushes and whispered: "He who cuts the reel shall die!"...
full_text:
A lazy wife told her husband she could not spin because she had no wooden reel. When he went to cut wood, she hid in the bushes and whispered: "He who cuts the reel shall die!"

The frightened husband dropped his axe, and she lived in peaceful idleness, proving that laziness can be wonderfully inventive.
moral: Excuses for idleness are woven with thread finer than silk.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Lazy Spinner"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
